title: EAL parity (bilingual side-by-side + per-pupil reading age memory)
description: Bring the bilingual print mode the Parent Newsletter has to every worksheet: side-by-side Polish / Urdu / Romanian / Arabic / Bengali / Gujarati / Punjabi / Mandarin / Spanish (the actual top 9 UK EAL languages). Add a per-pupil reading-age override that the tool remembers so every worksheet that pupil receives is automatically tuned without the teacher choosing.
rationale: User's improvement #9. EAL is currently a manual chore in every other UK SEND tool — owning this category is realistic with the existing ParentNewsletter translation infra and AI translation pass.
constraints: RTL languages (Arabic, Urdu) require correct page direction in print, not just text dir — page columns must mirror.
Translation runs as a non-blocking post-process. Pupil-view print path always honours both columns when the worksheet has a translation; teacher key remains English-only.
No paid translation API. Use the existing free-tier AI providers; cap per-pupil translations to one per worksheet to control cost.
steps: Audit ParentNewsletter's translation flow (grep `translate` + `targetLanguage` in client/src/pages/tools/ParentNewsletter.tsx). Extract its `aiTranslate` helper to client/src/lib/aiTranslate.ts so worksheets can reuse it.

Extend Child schema (already-additive fields are safe): add `Child.readingAgeOverride: number | null`, `Child.preferredLanguage: 'en'|'pl'|'ur'|'ro'|'ar'|'bn'|'gu'|'pa'|'zh'|'es' | null`. Persist in localStorage; DB column migration is deferred to PC2's MIS migration.

- translateWorksheet(worksheet, targetLang): Promise<TranslatedWorksheet> — produces a parallel sections array with translated content. Caches per (worksheetId, targetLang) in localStorage so repeated views don't re-pay.
- getEffectiveReadingAge(child, fallback) — reads override, then yearGroup-derived default.

Generate-time: when a class brief contains a child with `preferredLanguage !== 'en'` AND class-pack mode is active (PR-3), the class-pack pipeline auto-fires translateWorksheet per such pupil and inserts the bilingual side-by-side into THAT pupil's named copy only.

Render: WorksheetRenderer learns a `bilingual?: { lang; sections }` prop. When present, it renders each section in two columns (CSS grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr) with `dir='rtl'` applied to the RTL column. Print + PDF respect the same layout — pdf-generator-v2's options gain `bilingual?: { lang }`.
- Add a field on the pupil profile page + class-pack pupil row.

- aiGenerateWorksheetFromClassBrief (and aiGenerateWorksheet directly) honour the override when generating per-pupil tier in class-pack — the ReadingAge slider in advanced options shows the override as the default for that pupil.
- client/src/lib/__tests__/worksheetTranslator.test.ts — cache hit/miss, RTL flag pass-through, error fallback returns English-only.
- Snapshot: WorksheetRenderer with bilingual: {lang: 'ar'} fixture produces dir=rtl on the second column.
Docs: docs/eal.md listing the supported languages + the script the teacher uses.
do_not_touch: Existing ParentNewsletter behaviour (we extract the helper without changing the page's flow)
Worksheet schema beyond optional bilingual sidecar field
acceptance_criteria: A class-pack run on a class with one Polish-preferred pupil produces a Class Pack PDF where that pupil's named copy has the worksheet in EN + PL side-by-side; other pupils' copies are unchanged.
Arabic-preferred renders the right column with dir=rtl correctly in print preview.
Per-pupil reading-age override is persisted and consumed by Auto-from-class generation.
Translation cache prevents re-translating the same (worksheet, lang) pair twice in a session.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build + pnpm test --run pass.
verification: Manual: print a 4-pupil class pack with one Polish + one Arabic preferred; verify both bilingual layouts.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. ParentNewsletter (~350 LOC) read in full to extract the helper; ClassPackDialog (475 LOC) read in full.
